nodes.label: ADR 0160: GLUE Home's service in its engine
nodes.rationale: Moves all GLUE Home service functionality (status, timers, backups, reminders, updates, native check) from hidden WebView page into Rust engine to eliminate renderer process, unify behavior in one language, and finish architectural refactor from plan E1-E5

nodes.label: GLUE Home service: status, timers, backups, reminders, updates
nodes.rationale: Service logic now in Rust engine (crates/glue-engine/src/service.rs): status JSON assembly and push (to tray, settings window), event history (last 30), activity tracking, sync/backup/reminder timers, tokens, music folder discovery, settings application, native check loop
